'''The Wall''' was a huge wall surrounding the jungle on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Prior to [[3643 BBY]], it was used to keep out invaders during periods of civil war on the planet.<ref name="TORGuide">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref> The entrance to the Wall was also known as the '''Emperor's Gates'''.<ref name="SW desc">{{TORcite|type=general|Strange Weapons|Dromund Kaas}} {{C|Mission description}}</ref> Nearly a hundred [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were assigned to the sector surrounding the wall, some posted on the wall itself, others watching the nearby rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]]. These soldiers were under the command of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarnova]].<ref name="TWM">{{TORcite|type=general|The War Machine|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>
